property_summary: After owner transfers ownership to address(0), the reference allows it while the buggy version reverts due to requiring newOwner != address(1) incorrectly allowing address(0) but preventing address(1) - but the actual difference is that reference rejects address(0) via the original require, while the buggy version allows address(0) because it only checks for address(1). So we test: owner calls transferOwnership(address(0)) - reference reverts, buggy version succeeds.
change_summary: Replace the require(newOwner != address(0), ...) with require(newOwner != address(1), ...) so that only address(1) is rejected, but address(0) becomes allowed.
